about.title: JUST AUDIT
about.paragraph1: Just Audit is an audit and consulting firm performing financial statement audits and related services in accordance with ISA, IFRS, and the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
about.paragraph2: The audit opinion confirms the reliability of financial statements — for owners and investors, banks and creditors, government bodies and regulators.
about.paragraph3: We work with companies of any size and industry — from private businesses to the quasi-public sector and Astana Hub participants.
